furrows: * Eight furrows, burned into the road side by side.
* They come down from the north, from the Hollow, and run south toward the Waystone. Whatever made them was dragged, not walking.
fork_lantern: * A trail lantern. It is dark, but someone refilled it, not long ago.
* The oil smells of the Azurelake guild stores. The wick is new, and it has never been lit.
signpost: * The signpost has been scorched blank.
* The left arm points along the furrows. The right one points toward a dark shape rising over the trees.

serpent_bed: * A great coil pressed into the earth, still warm under the ash.
* Orochi slept here, until something pulled it south. The earth at the south rim is torn, as if it held on.
cold_camp: * A cold fire ring. One bedroll, and two small blankets folded beside it.
* The fire ring is days older than the bedding, as if the camp was made long before the children came.
* The blankets were folded with care.
split_tree: * The trunk is split from crown to root. The wood inside is burned black, as if lightning had come from below.

norwoods_mangal_roots.name: Norwoods — Roots of the Giant Mangal

mangal_trunk: * The Giant Mangal. Its crown is lost somewhere above the night.
* Floor upon floor of hollowed wood. Hunters say it goes up eight.
hunters_board: * A notice from the Dundean hunters: "Barbarian sighted again in the Giant Mangal. Do not climb alone."
* Beneath it, fresh charcoal: "The Ashen one did not climb. He went east."
barricade: * The hunters' barricade has been shoved aside. One plank is split clean through.
* Grey ash on the sill of the root door. It goes in, and it comes out again.

giant_mangal_f1.name: Giant Mangal — First Floor

stair_barricade: * The stair up is lashed shut with rope and timber.
* Carved in the wood: "Closed by order of the Dundean hunters. Ask at the lodge."
* At the foot of the stair, a little grey ash, where someone stood a long while looking up. The lashings were not touched.
dropped_spear: * A hunter's spear, its haft snapped. There is no blood on it.
* Whoever dropped it ran, and did not come back for it.

frontier: * The stair up is lashed shut with rope and timber.
* Carved in the wood: "Closed by order of the Dundean hunters. Ask at the lodge."

milestone: * A milestone. Under the moss, the old carving reads one word: MANGAL.
* The other side has been scraped smooth.
causeway: * The planks are new. The posts under them are very old.
* Something large moves beneath the water, then goes still.

mangal_crossroads.name: Forest of Mangal — Crossroads

signpost4: * South: the Waystone. East: the Safaris, and Dundean. North: Ringfeld.
* The fourth arm has been snapped off and left in the mud.
fallen_trunk: * A mangal trunk has come down across the north road, and the ground beyond it has slid into the ravine.
* A hunter's mark is cut into the bark: "Ringfeld road. Clearing by spring." Someone could not wait: planks have been laid round the slide.
shrine: * A low stone shrine. Travellers have left coins, dried flowers, a child's carved bird.
* The candles in the shrine are cold. Their wicks have been pinched flat, every one.
* The bird's eyes are two small crossed notches, the way Kael cuts them. He learned it so young he cannot remember who showed him.
* Kael turns it over in his hand. "I never carved Lira a bird."

frontier: * A fallen mangal trunk lies across the north road, and the ground beyond it has slid into the ravine.
* A path of planks and rope skirts the edge of the slide, north toward Ringfeld.

timber_frame: * A building frame, half raised. The ropes were cut, not frayed.
torn_notice: * A notice: "This site was attacked by locals. Work halted. Breeders sent to clear the area have not returned."
* Someone has scratched a name into the corner: Iris.
cart: * An overturned cart. The crates were broken open and emptied. Whatever was inside, someone wanted it.

waymarker: * A waymarker. East: Dundean. South: the river.
* Its lantern is kept full. Someone in the village still cares who walks this road.
hunters_blind: * A hunter's blind of woven reeds. Inside, a tally carved into a post: three marks, then a line struck through all of them.
west_grove: * A small, twisted grove. The ground under it glints like wet iron.
* Hunters keep their distance. Something heavy and slow lives here.

river_house: * A small house by the river. The shutters are closed and the hearth is cold.
* No one has slept here for days. The rowboat at the jetty has no oars.
jetty: * A rowboat, tied fast. Its oars are gone.
* Pale shapes turn slowly under the jetty, then sink away.

well: * The Dundean well. The rope is new; the stones are worn hollow by hands.
* The water is cold and clean.
inn: * The inn's door stands open. Smoke, bread, and low voices.
* A few hunters drink in silence. Nobody laughs.
lodge: * The hunters' lodge. A board by the door lists names. Several are crossed out in fresh ink.
* The old crossings each have a year beside them. The fresh ones have none.
* At the top, a notice: "Barbarian sighted again in the Giant Mangal."

dundean_east_gate.name: Dundean — Valley Gate

barred_gate: * The valley gate is barred with a beam as thick as a man.
* Chalked on it: "Longdale road closed. A dragon guards the pass."
watchtower: * The brazier on the tower burns all night. Down the valley, a red glow answers it from the cliffs.
trough: * Hoofprints in the mud, one horse, going east up the valley and coming back again.
* Beside them, two sets of small boots, and a man's prints with grey ash pressed into each heel.

frontier: * The valley gate is barred with a beam as thick as a man.
* Chalked on it: "Longdale road closed. A dragon guards the pass."

east_valley_road.name: East Valley — Longdale Road

waymarker: * A waymarker. The east arm is carved LONGDALE. The south arm has been cut away.
* Someone has scratched a circle into the stump of it, and filled the circle in with something dark.
felled_pine: * A pine lies across the valley road. Felled, not fallen. Brann's mark is cut into the trunk.
* Beyond it the road climbs toward the red glow in the cliffs. The hunters closed it. Not tonight.
boot_prints: * Many feet have gone down the south track toward the graveyard. Most of them bare. The steps are even. No one was pulled.
* None of the tracks come back up.

frontier: * A pine lies across the valley road. Felled, not fallen. Brann's mark is cut into the trunk.
* Beyond it the road climbs toward the red glow in the cliffs. The hunters closed it. Not tonight.

lichgate: * The lichgate's chain has been cut. A cloth is tied to the post, stiff and brown.
* Grey ash lies cold along the sill, as if someone stood here a long time with a hand on the post.
* The braziers inside are new. Someone keeps them fed.
sealed_crypt: * An old family crypt. The names on the lintel have been chiselled off.
* Fresh mortar seals the door. From inside, nothing at all.
headstones: * Dundean names. Generations of hunters, laid in rows.
* Several graves have been opened, and filled again badly.
* Beside a stone carved with a hunting horn, a small grave lies open. The earth inside is old and clean. Nothing was ever buried there.

open_crypt: * The crypt is empty. The stone shelves have been swept clean of bones.
* On the floor, a circle drawn in something that has dried black.
red_cloths: * Strips of red cloth tied to every branch. Dozens. Each has a knot for a name.
* It is the same careful knot as the one in Lira's ribbon.
* The wind moves them. The sound is like breathing.
steps: * Chanting comes down the steps, low and steady. More than a dozen voices.
* The red light above does not flicker like fire should.

standing_stones: * The stones are older than Dundean. Older than the graves around them.
* Fresh handprints in red climb every one of them, all facing the altar.
altar: * The altar is stained to the depth of a finger. This rite has been fed for a long time.
* A clean rectangle in the ash on the altar, where a page lay.
* FORMULA FRAGMENT (BLOOD) obtained. Half of a combination: Blood Rogue, and a second name torn away.
rest_stone: * A flat stone at the foot of the ring, worn smooth by those who knelt here before going up.
* A rest candle burns on it, its wick freshly trimmed. Someone tends it, here, inside the rite.

banner_poles: * Prayer banners, faded to the colour of bone. The words on them have been worn off by the wind.
* They all point the same way. Uphill.
landing: * The far jetty is newer than the near one. Someone has been crossing often.
* The same small wheel as on Edda's oars is burned into the mooring post.
cracked_lantern: * The lantern's glass is cracked. The old wick has been pinched flat between two fingers.
* A new wick is threaded beside it, and the oil is fresh. No one lit it.

wind_chimes: * Flat stones on cords, knocking together in the wind. Each one is carved with a single mark: a wheel.
* Some of the stones are new. Someone is still carving them.
ruined_hut: * A shepherd's hut, roof fallen in. Inside, a bedroll, a hunting knife, Dundean boots.
* There are no shoes among the priests on the terraces. Grey ash lies on the sill.
* Edda said three of the young ones went up the hill. One of them did not go far.
niche: * A niche in the wall, out of the wind. A candle burns here, steady, the only still flame on the hill.
* Whatever the chimes are doing, this flame does not lean. Someone keeps it.

wind_shrine: * The wind-wheel is cut deep and old. The banners around it are new, and hung by many hands.
* A pale square in the dust of the crack behind the wind-wheel, where something was pressed.
* FORMULA FRAGMENT (WIND) obtained. Half of a combination: a name torn away, and Cult Rogue.
feather_basin: * A basin of pale feathers. The wind should scatter them. It does not.
far_lamps: * Far below, a few lamps across the water. The brightest is the inn at Dundean.
* From up here, someone could watch every light in the Safaris, and know which ones were kept.

spear_rack: * A spear-rack, knocked flat. Hunters camped here. Their fire was put out with water, not left to die.
* Someone scratched a tally into the root beside it. It stops at the second floor.
broken_shafts: * Spear-shafts lie snapped on the lower treads of the upper stair. Lodge spears.
* The hunters who barred the first floor came down this way, and they did not stop to pick these up.
fungus_wall: * The fungus gives off a cold light, like moonlight through water.
* A long stripe of it has been scraped off the wall at shoulder height, as if someone had steadied himself here in the dark.

giant_mangal_f3.name: Giant Mangal — Third Floor, the Waypoint

waypoint: * A waypoint. The carved ring in the stone glows faintly, like a coal under ash.
* Hunters mark these so they can come back to the same floor. Whoever comes back here will start from this stone.
torn_stair: * The upper stair has been ripped away. Not cut. Torn.
* The lodge barred the first floor and called it a barbarian. Looking at this, Kael is not sure the lodge knows what lives up there.
count_of_floors: * Eight notches cut into the root, one for each floor. Two are marked with a waypoint ring: the third, and the sixth.
* Beside the seventh, a hunter has carved a small blade. Beside the eighth, nothing. The cut there was never finished.

frontier: * The stair to the fourth floor has been torn out of the trunk. The splinters are fresh; the sap is still running.
* Far above, something heavy moves on the wood, and the whole tree creaks. Not yet.

plank_path: * Someone has laid planks along the lip of the slide and staked a rope beside them. The rope is new.
* The mark on the trunk said spring. The keepers on the coast could not wait for spring.
field_wall: * An old field wall of stacked stone. A section has been pulled down to let a cart through.
* The wheel ruts go north, toward the sea.
creek_bridge: * The creek tastes of salt. The sea is close.
* Fine grey flakes ride on the water, drifting down from inland. Kael has seen this ash before.

shelter_well: * A covered well. The rope is wet; someone drew water tonight.
* Cut into the well-cap: a column of short marks, each with a year. The years are far apart, and evenly spaced.
* The newest mark has no year beside it, and below it the stone has been smoothed flat.
dark_lighthouse: * Out on the rock, the Lighthouse stands dark. No lamp has burned in it for many nights.
* The water between here and the rock is never still. Even with no wind.
empty_cart: * A keepers' cart, its traces cut. Grey ash has settled in the boards.
* It came on the wind, from inland. Kael wipes a finger through it. It is cold.

ringfeld_shore_road.name: Ringfeld — Shore Road

causeway_lantern: * The lantern is lit. The keepers fill it at every dusk, and it burns lower each night than it should.
* Beyond it, the causeway runs out into the dark and then simply stops.
wreck: * A keeper's boat, broken in half. The planks are not rotten. They are crushed.
* Whatever did this came from below.
tide_marks: * A line of grey ash along the high-water mark, as if the sea had been asked to carry it away and refused.
* It fell here the night the Norwoods shook. Whatever he is, his ash reaches further than his road.

frontier: * The causeway is broken halfway to the rock. The sea boils white over the gap, and something long turns under the water.
* The keepers say the overlord of these waters lets nothing cross to the Lighthouse. Not tonight.

felled_pine_moved: * The pine Brann felled has been hauled off the road with ropes and oxen. His lodge mark is on the cut end.
* He kept his word. The road is open. What waits up it is not his to keep.
drovers_hut: * A drovers' hut. The roof is down. Inside, three bedrolls laid side by side: one large, two small.
* They are lodge bedrolls, laid out and the fire built before anyone came. Grey ash lies in the hollow of the large one.
* The fire burned down to cold black embers. He let the children sleep. Then he went on.
red_cleft: * The red light is not fire. It does not flicker. It is cold to look at, the same cold red as the stones of the Blood Circle.
* Hunters' marks are scratched on the boulders here, all pointing back down the valley.

still_pool: * The falls pour into the pool, and the pool does not move. Not a ripple.
* Then, once, the whole surface shivers, though nothing has touched it.
* Something very large lies under the surface. It has been lying there a long time.
red_shrine: * An old shrine, cut into the cliff out of reach. The red light comes from inside it.
* There is grey ash on the ledge below it. He climbed up there. Kael cannot see how.
weir_tracks: * Across the wet weir: one man's prints, and between them, two pairs of small ones.
* They crossed in front of the pool and nothing stopped them. Kael does not understand that. He does not like it.

milestone: * A milestone. LONGDALE, it says, and below that a number worn smooth.
* A blue thread is knotted around its foot, in the same careful knot as the ribbon.
lamp_niche: * A shrine niche with an oil lamp. The old wick has been pinched out.
* A new one has been threaded beside it, and the oil is fresh. No one lit it.
* Travellers light it after the pass, to give thanks. No one has, tonight.
river_bridge: * A stone bridge over the river. The road does not cross it.
* South, the river runs on toward Wesburn. The ash is not on the bridge. He did not go south.

longdale_square.name: Longdale — Guild Square

guild_board: * The board is full. More notices than any town Kael has seen. Most are bounties.
* Pinned at the top, in a guild hand: "By word of Azurelake: a man in ash, two children.
* Return the children unharmed. The man is of no account."
* Azurelake's word came this far ahead of him. Kael is glad of it.
* One reads: "A notorious criminal called al-Rashid has escaped the prisons of Dundean.
* He is said to have run into the cave north of here."
* Another: "Follow the river south from here. A barbarian has been sighted in the forest on the west bank."
* Someone has written CYRUS beside it.
trough: * The water in the trough has a skin of grey on it.
* Ash. Days old, and still floating.
north_gate: * The north gate, barred for the night.
* Past it, the mountain road climbs toward the cave the notices speak of.

frontier: * The north gate is shut and barred. Dale-ward closes at dusk, and the ward will not open it before light.
* At the foot of the gate, in the frost, grey ash. He went north.
